name: dekspec
description: DekSpec library marketplace — Spec-Driven Development tooling, methodology, and authoring aids for the Dektora family of projects.

plugins.name: dekspec
plugins.description: Consumer-facing plugin: slash commands, authoring agents, and audit hooks for DekSpec. Wraps the dekspec CLI and complements vendored content. Install this on every consumer repo.

plugins.name: dektools
plugins.description: Optional DekSpec operator toolkit (ADR-047): project boards, code-quality/security review, brownfield onboarding, handoff, troubleshooting, issue-tracker glue. À-la-carte — nothing on by default. Install alongside dekspec when you want the helpers.
